review_evidence: Complete unit inventory covers 240 files: 159 under Linglib/Syntax and 81 under Linglib/Phonology; every file owns declarations and 192 files contain 1,907 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.

The syntax side includes Minimalist, categorial, HPSG, construction/dependency/word grammar, case and agreement frameworks; the phonology side includes subregular, autosegmental, optimality-theoretic, harmonic-grammar, prosodic and tone formalisms.
Path names such as Demonstrative are linguistic technical vocabulary rather than demo/test markers; no reviewed subtree is disposable scaffolding.
summary: Retain the complete Linglib syntax/phonology unit as substantive formal grammar and phonological theory.

review_evidence: Listed 252 files; all exist in the checkout, all are .lean, and none lie outside Linglib/Syntax and Linglib/Phonology.

Ran a Lean declaration-keyword grep (theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom|opaque, with attribute/modifier prefixes) over every listed file: every file has at least one declaration. Total matched declaration lines: 5851.
Read completely: Linglib/Syntax/Category/Degree/Basic.lean (smallest, 879 B): inductive Degree.Head with five documented constructors.

Sampled declaration heads from the first file of each subdirectory (Autosegmental, FeatureGeometry, HarmonicGrammar, Harmony, OCP, OptimalityTheory, Prosody, Segmental, Subregular, Tone, Agreement, Binding, CCG, Case, Category, Clause, Command, ConstructionGrammar, Control, DependencyGrammar, Gender, HPSG, Mereological, Minimalist, Negation, Number, Person, Tree, Voice, WordOrder): e.g. IsTierOrdered, naturalClass, expWeights_pos, TierStrictlyLocalGrammar.agree, commandRelation_union, isClosestGoalIn.

Largest files are OptimalityTheory/Antimatroid.lean (60196 B), PartiallyOrderedConstraints.lean (38927 B), Minimalist/Merge/Sideward.lean (35960 B); all carry many declarations. 11 files have at most 2 declarations; all are short (under 3.7 kB) typed definition files.

Grepped every listed file for LLM-transcript markers (as an AI, ```, claude, chatgpt, assistant:): 2 hits (Phonology/Prosody/Grid.lean, Syntax/Number/Basic.lean), the same marker class as in the sibling units (markdown fences in doc comments).
Whole-set `sorry` word count: 2; incomplete proofs do not remove formal statements from search.
summary: Surveyed all 252 listed files of Linglib/Syntax and Linglib/Phonology (Syntax/Minimalist 59, Syntax/Category 34, Phonology/Subregular 21, Phonology/OptimalityTheory 14, Phonology/Autosegmental 12, Syntax/Agreement 10, and others) by size and declaration count, read the smallest and low-declaration outlier files completely, and sampled declarations from one file per subdirectory. All files are .lean sources inside the main library tree, every file has formal declarations (5851 matched in total), and no file is generated data, a transcript, or a stub. Every file stays searchable; no exclusions.
